title: Lamb Tagine with a Cheesy Crust
description: A flavorful and aromatic Moroccan dish with a gooey cheesy crust. The combination of lamb and eastern spices will transport your taste buds to the bustling markets of Marrakech.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper, eastern paprika, and eastern cumin.
Heat the eastern olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the middle eastern spices to the pot and stir to combine. Add 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falls apart easily.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the cheesy crust. Mix the crumbled goat cheese with 1 tablespoon of eastern olive oil and 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh parsley.
When the lamb is done, remove it from the pot and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Transfer the lamb to a serving platter and top with the cheesy crust.
Serve with middle eastern flatbread on the side and garnish with additional parsley if desired.
To make the flatbread, simply warm it in the oven for a few minutes or grill it until crispy.
